name: wisepim
description: Connect WISEPIM product information management to ChatGPT and Codex: search your catalog, review product data quality, and prepare native AI enrichment and translations for approval in WISEPIM.

interface.longDescription: Connect WISEPIM, your product information management (PIM) workspace, to ChatGPT and Codex. Search your product catalog with precise filters, find missing descriptions, and inspect stored product data quality. Prepare native AI product data enrichment and product translation using WISEPIM workflows, project settings, and configured languages. Review the selected products, operation, and available credit estimate before approval in WISEPIM. Track actual job progress and verify saved results; queued work is not completed work. Each connection authorizes one project. Channel-readiness reviews explain available evidence and unknown requirements; they do not certify, export, or publish products.
defaultPrompt: Find products missing descriptions in my connected WISEPIM project and explain the quality gaps.
Prepare German descriptions for products I select; show the translation scope and WISEPIM review link.
Review my selected products against sales-channel requirements and identify missing or unverified evidence.
